spans.s: विज् vt. 3U (pp. विक्त; pres. वेवेक्ति, वेविक्ते) To separate, to distinguish, to discern. (generally with वि.)

विज् vi. 6Ā, 7P (pp. विग्न; pres. विजते, विनक्ति) 1. To shake, to tremble; 2. to tremble with fear; 3. to be afraid; 4. to be distressed.With उद्-, 1. to be afraid of, to fear, (with an abl. or gen.), यस्मानोद्विकते लोको लोकान्नेद्विजते च यः Bg.xii.15; 2. to be disgusted, (with an abl.), e.g. उद्विनक्ति तु संसारादसारात् (मनः); 3. to be distressed, to be sorry, न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राफ्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम् Bg.v.19; 4. to afflict, to frighten.
वीज् (I) vt. 1Ā (pres. वीजते) To go, to move.
वीज् (II) vt. 10U (pres. वीजयति-ते) To fan, to cool by fanning, वीज्यते स हि संसुप्तः श्वाससाधारणानिलैः (चामरैः) K.S.ii.42.With अभि-, to fan, चामरशतैरभिवीज्यमानः Rt.iii.4.
विजन (I) a. (f. ना) Lonely, solitary.
विजन (II) n. A solitary place.
विजन (I) a. (f. ना) Lonely, solitary.
विज्जन(ल) n. 1. A kind of sauce; 2. an arrow.
वीजन (I) m. 1. The ruddy goose; 2. a kind of pheasant.
वीजन (II) n. 1. Fanning, K.S.iv.36; 2. a fan.
विजनन n. Delivery, birth, procreation.
विजन्मन् m. A bastard.
विजपिल n. Mud.

विजय m. 1. Conquest, victory, K.S.iii.19, R.xii.44, M.x.119; 2. a celestial car; 3. an epithet of Arjuna, (thus derived in this sense- अभिप्रयामि संग्रामे यदहं युद्धदुर्मदान् । नाजित्वा विनिवर्तामि तेन मां विजयं विदुः); 4. name of an attendant of Viṣṇu; 5. an epithet of Yama.
विजया f. 1. An epithet of Durgā; 2. hemp; 3. a festival held in honour of Durgā on the tenth day of the light half of Āśvina.
विजय-अभ्युपाय m. a means of victory.
विजय-कुंजर m. a war-elephant.
विजय-च्छद m. a necklace of 500 strings.
विजय-डिंडिम m. a military drum.
विजय-नगर n. name of a town.
विजय-मर्दल m. a military drum.
विजय-सिद्धि f. victory, success.
विजयंत m. An epithet of Indra.
विजया-उत्सव m. a festival held in honour of Durgā on the tenth day of the light half of Āśvina.
विजया-दशमी f. the tenth day of the light half of Āśvina.
विजयिन् m. A conqueror.

विजातीय a. (f. या) 1. Dissimilar; 2. of different caste; 3. of mixed origin.

विजिगीषु (II) m. 1. A disputant, an opponent, an antagonist; 2. a warrior.
